recommendation: Keep the commit. Do not use FHIR-5644 to reintroduce a direct BodySite choice; any desired first-class MedicationAdministration bodyStructure or CodeableReference element should be raised as a new Pharmacy tracker because FHIR-10735 superseded the original direct-reference modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-5644 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked, as a Pharmacy follow-up to FHIR-3600, to change MedicationAdministration.dosage.site to a bodySite-style CodeableConcept|Reference(BodySite) choice using the same value set as current resources.
initial_application: No git commit was found that mentions FHIR-5644 directly. The same application trail appears through FHIR-6253: commit c765f2b228b307043933ea0c2b106ffd8529e2eb changed MedicationAdministration.dosage.site to MedicationAdministration.dosage.site[x] with CodeableConcept | Reference(BodySite), and FHIR-6253 comments record the Pharmacy resource updates in SVN 6619-6621.
additional_context: FHIR-6253 already documented the WG preference that BodySite references be handled as an extension because a simple CodeableConcept is generally sufficient in core. FHIR-10735 later made that the controlling rule for inconsistent BodySite direct references; Pharmacy agreed to CodeableConcept only, and commit 6e938aa2cf6f9d2262954ae81884d995a149afd1 removed the MedicationAdministration site[x] choice while adding extension guidance. FHIR-13396 renamed BodySite to BodyStructure, and the current Extension Pack bodySite extension is allowed on MedicationAdministration.dosage and targets Reference(BodyStructure). Pharmacy 2021 WGM minutes also describe MedicationAdministration.device, dosage.site, and/or bodySite (BodyStructure) extension as available.
reconciliation: Made one source edit in source/medicationadministration/structuredefinition-MedicationAdministration.xml: the dosage.site comment now says BodyStructure resource while preserving the later FHIR-10735 CodeableConcept-only shape and the standard bodySite extension link.
source_changes: source/medicationadministration/structuredefinition-MedicationAdministration.xml: changed the MedicationAdministration.dosage.site comment from BodySite resource to BodyStructure resource while retaining the standard bodySite extension guidance.
